activity_logs_actor_check.name: activity_logs_actor_check
activity_logs_actor_check.value: ("activity_logs"."actor_kind" = 'api_key') = ("activity_logs"."actor_api_key_id" is not null) and ("activity_logs"."actor_user_id" is null or "activity_logs"."actor_kind" = 'user')

videos_processing_run_check.name: videos_processing_run_check
videos_processing_run_check.value: ("videos"."processing_run_id" is null and "videos"."processing_heartbeat_at" is null) or "videos"."processing_status" = 'processing'
